reference_appeal_text:
To: The Insurance Ombudsman, Chennai

Subject: Appeal against wrongful repudiation of Claim CLM-2024-1197 for Aortic Valve Replacement

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, Padma Srinivasan, holder of Care Supreme policy with Care Health, hereby appeal the denial of my claim CLM-2024-1197 for Aortic Valve Replacement performed at Aster MIMS, Kozhikode on 2024-06-24.

The insurer has wrongfully denied coverage citing 4.3 (Elective Surgery Exclusion). However, as documented in the attached medical records, I have undergone 15 months of conservative treatment including physical therapy, steroid injections, and medications, which have failed to provide relief. The treating specialist has certified that surgery was the only viable option.

Sub-clause 4.3.2 of the policy clearly states that elective procedures are covered when conservative medical management has failed for a period exceeding six months. My case meets this exception criterion.

I request the honorable Insurance Ombudsman to direct Care Health to honour my claim in full.

Yours faithfully,
Padma Srinivasan
